newsitem.title: USA: Aetna sets up $15 mln research fund.
newsitem.headline: Aetna sets up $15 mln research fund.

text.p: Insurance giant Aetna said Thursday it had set up a $15 million Quality Care Research Fund by the Aetna Foundation to strengthen ties between academic medical centers, teaching hospitals and managed care.

The fund will make grants to academic medical institutions and teaching hospitals that are members of a new organization set up by Aetna U.S. Healthcare called the Academic Medicine and Managed Care Forum.

"By organizing the Forum, we are creating a collaborative working relationship with academic medical institutions that will help us work together to fulfill the promise of managed care -- to improve both the quality and efficiency of health care delivery in America," Aetna U.S. Healthcare Co-President Joseph Sebastianelli said in a statement.
The Aetna Foundation Board will make final grant decisions, based on recommendations from the Forum, and results of the research projects will be published. --Hartford newsroom
